evidence.summary: A physical controller produced button and analog input observed by the host integration while the private program progressed, and rumble commands were issued without a recorded host-side failure in the observed run.

retention.limitation: Private telemetry is withheld; this record is a sanitized summary of the project record.

limitations: The observation covers the exercised controller path only.
It does not establish every binding, controller type, or multi-controller behavior.
